headline: Bring the required proofs to the transition.
subhead: Proposed proof-carrying financial workflows, with explicit conditions before settlement. This page explores the Cardano experiment; Moriarty’s broader target is Midnight.
utilityIntro: A Web is the proposed script-bound collection of Strands a consuming contract requires for one transition. Each Strand is an individual proof with its claim, statement, and binding metadata. Start with exact assets, recipients, fees, and duties; make the handoff to the consuming script inspectable.

usps.title: See the payment, fee, and remainder.
usps.body: Illustrative invoice: payment 35 CASH plus fee 2 debits escrow by 37. Invoice duty falls from 100 to 65; reserve duty stays 10. Source funding 110 leaves cash 73 against duties 75.
usps.limits: Proposed funding 112 backs those duties for one partial only. Later partials add fees. These are worksheet amounts, not execution results or an all-in transaction quote.

usps.title: Give every proof a defined job.
usps.body: Follow a claim specification from its assertion and subject to a concrete Strand and its consuming script. Inspect which statement, context, and consumer must agree.
usps.limits: A claim specification defines a requirement. Illustrated proof roles are not concrete Strands; assembling the illustration establishes no settlement.

closing.title: Start with one useful action.
closing.body: Bring exact assets, participants, conditions, fees, and remaining duties. Use the examples to make the proof-to-transaction handoff concrete.
